action.heading: Unsubscribe from the *newsletter*
action.text: Press the button below and I’ll remove your email address from the mailing list straight away.

done.heading: You’ve been *unsubscribed*
done.text: Your email address has been removed and you won’t receive any more newsletters. Thank you for being part of it. You’re always welcome back.

invalid.heading: Already *unsubscribed*
invalid.text: This email address isn’t on the mailing list any more, so there’s nothing else to do. If you keep getting emails, please [let me know](./#contact).
